name: ai.oruk/speech
title: oruk Speech
description: Hosted speech-to-text and speech emotion/tone analysis for agents: transcription plus calibrated emotion and speaking-style scores from English audio (up to 30 MB / 60 min), model and pricing lookup, and no-account trial keys. The only MCP that scores how something was said, not just the words.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <oruk API key>. Optional: model/pricing lookup, quickstart, and trial-key minting work without it. Get a key at https://oruk.ai/account (new accounts receive $50 trial credit).
